avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce budesonide bioavailability and therapeutic effect
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplement if mood support needed

avoid_supplements.name: Licorice Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive mineralocorticoid effects may cause hypokalemia, hypertension, and fluid retention when combined with budesonide
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; monitor potassium and blood pressure if concurrent use unavoidable

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may slightly increase budesonide levels, though clinical significance is minimal for inhaled formulations
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased corticosteroid side effects; generally safe for inhaled budesonide

caution_supplements.name: Calcium/Vitamin D Supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Budesonide may impair calcium absorption; supplementation supports bone health during long-term therapy
caution_supplements.action: Recommend concurrent use to mitigate osteoporosis risk with chronic budesonide use

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases budesonide systemic exposure, particularly with oral formulations
avoid_foods.action: Avoid grapefruit juice; fresh grapefruit has minimal effect on inhaled formulations

caution_foods.name: High-Sodium Foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Budesonide may cause sodium retention and fluid accumulation; high sodium intake increases risk
caution_foods.action: Encourage moderate sodium restriction, especially during long-term therapy

caution_foods.name: Potassium-Depleting Foods/High Sugar
caution_foods.mechanism: Chronic corticosteroid use increases potassium loss and hyperglycemia risk
caution_foods.action: Monitor potassium levels; encourage potassium-rich foods (bananas, leafy greens) and moderate sugar intake

monitoring_notes: Monitor for systemic corticosteroid side effects (HPA axis suppression, osteoporosis, hyperglycemia) with chronic budesonide use, particularly with oral formulations. Counsel on potential drug-nutrient interactions and advise maintaining adequate calcium, vitamin D, and potassium intake.
